versions.content: NID/CBV signals shall be ignored by Ecuc tools If NID/CBV are enabled ( nmCbvPosition and nmNidPosition are configured), the Signals that are defined at the position of the respective NID/CBV bytes shall be ignored by Base Ecuc generators since these signals are not processed by COM.
